VME_InsectoidSupremacy.descriptionMaker..li: creation(tag=meme_InsectoidSupremacy)->[deity0_name] placed the first queen beneath the poisoned earth and taught her brood to outlast the folly of humankind.
episode(uses=1,tag=meme_InsectoidSupremacy)->[deity0_name] commanded [deity0_possessive] followers to study the giant ants: one purpose, one colony, and no weakness wasted.
intro(tag=meme_InsectoidSupremacy)->In the ruins of [place_name], the [memberNamePlural] raised a human colony modeled after the ant nests beneath their feet.
conflict(tag=meme_InsectoidSupremacy)->A fearful [foeLeader] ordered every giant ant nest burned, refusing to see anything but vermin.
founderJoin(tag=meme_InsectoidSupremacy)->[founderName] confronted the [foeLeader] and demonstrated that the wasteland's ants could be understood, guided, and survived.
victory(tag=meme_InsectoidSupremacy)->The discipline of the colony prevailed, and even the [foeLeader] was forced to respect the queen and her brood.
setup(tag=meme_InsectoidSupremacy)->[founderName] was a wasteland naturalist who survived for years among irradiated ant colonies and learned to read their trails, pheromones, and warning signs.
story(uses=1,tag=meme_InsectoidSupremacy)->Calling [founder_objective] the AntAgonizer, settlers mocked the armor and sermons until trained giant ants drove off the raiders at their gates.
lessonIntro(tag=meme_InsectoidSupremacy)->The old world collapsed under its own divisions, while the colony endured. This proves that
lesson(tag=meme_InsectoidSupremacy)->discipline, sacrifice, and loyalty to the colony are stronger than isolated human ambition
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_InsectoidSupremacy)->Giant ants thrive in poisoned soil because every caste serves the whole. The wastes demand the same unity from us.
archistBasis(tag=meme_InsectoidSupremacy)->Pre-War laboratories altered the ant genome, but radiation and survival perfected what their scientists began.
archistFact(tag=meme_InsectoidSupremacy)->The giant ant is living proof that engineered life can escape its makers and master the wasteland.
archistProphecy(tag=meme_InsectoidSupremacy)->[inTheEnd], humanity will either learn the discipline of the colony or be swept aside by it.
animistBasis(tag=meme_InsectoidSupremacy)->The queen beneath the earth embodies endurance, fertility, and the will of the colony.
animistFact(tag=meme_InsectoidSupremacy)->Every worker, soldier, and queen carries the same unbroken purpose through the poisoned land.
animistProphecy(tag=meme_InsectoidSupremacy)->[itIsSaid] those who respect the trails and nests of the giant ants will never be abandoned by the land.
serketistProphecy(tag=meme_InsectoidSupremacy)->[itIsSaid] the faithful will become one colony beneath a queen strong enough to command the wastes.
chthonianProphecy(tag=meme_InsectoidSupremacy)->Deep nests touch forgotten caverns where mutant queens guard secrets no surface dweller was meant to know.
esotericismProphecy(tag=meme_InsectoidSupremacy)->Pheromone trails and the geometry of ant tunnels preserve a language older than any surviving settlement.
eschatologismFact(tag=meme_InsectoidSupremacy)->When the final settlements fall, the colonies beneath them will continue to feed, breed, and expand.
introMemo(tag=meme_InsectoidSupremacy)->Pest control is suspended. All giant ant sightings are to be reported to the colony handler for observation and possible conditioning.
alienistProphecy(tag=meme_InsectoidSupremacy)->The ant strains born from Pre-War experimentation are not mistakes; they are heirs adapted to the world humanity created.
